description: Header file defining structures and function prototypes for 3GPP confidentiality and integrity algorithms (SNOW 3G) within the ocudu::security namespace, including initialization, deinitialization, keystream generation, and MAC computation.

methods.name: s3g_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the S3G_STATE with a 128-bit key and IV for key generation.

methods.name: s3g_deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the S3G_STATE, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: s3g_generate_keystream
methods.description: Generates a keystream of specified length in 32-bit words.

methods.name: s3g_f9
methods.description: Computes a 32-bit MAC using the UIA2 algorithm with provided inputs.
